report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Arjun Mehta | Age: 33
Body Temperature at Scene: 21.8°C | Ambient Temperature: 21.2°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 11.7 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  2. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  3. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  4. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): GHB, Ethanol

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
